canonical_byte_composition.delimiter_assignment: Each section span includes its leading comma/key and its emitted value; the schema/basic header starts at byte 0. The spans are contiguous and there is no unassigned delimiter remainder.

evidence.canonical_section_byte_integrity: derived from exact emitted section-span sum
evidence.focused_shape_equivalence: derived from six-fixture shape/no-shape byte/hash test marker
evidence.gate_evidence_complete: derived from non-empty evidence for every externally declared PASS gate
evidence.measured_run_binary_identity: derived from run-time worker SHA-256 and source identity binding
evidence.residual_timing_integrity: derived from explicit per-record residual-underflow flags and zero aggregate underflows
evidence.semantic_trace_equivalence: derived from frozen-reference trace, observation-hash, gameplay-hash, and step equality
evidence.shape_record_completeness: derived from sidecar completeness and shape/lifecycle key join

gate_provenance.mode: PASS statuses are bound to an immutable gate-evidence manifest with exit codes and stdout/stderr hashes; internal gates are derived from the run and report invariants.

instrumentation_overhead_check.interpretation: The delta measures the effect of the optional shape probe plus run-to-run machine variation. It is diagnostic evidence only and is not a throughput claim or an optimization authorization.
instrumentation_overhead_check.method: Compare the shape-enabled Release worker against a same-source, same-toolchain Release control compiled with YGO_M4_PERFORMANCE_AUDIT but without YGO_M4_SERIALIZATION_SHAPE_AUDIT. This is a workload-level overhead signal, not an isolated microbenchmark.

evidence.unmeasured_residual_components: remaining stream formatting, primitive formatting, output construction, and probe overhead

optimization_candidates.name: rendering_output_stream
optimization_candidates.proposed_optimization_concept: A/B test a reserve-backed append implementation while preserving the exact existing field order and escaping.
optimization_candidates.required_equivalence_test: All 9,908 canonical-without-hash byte strings and observation hashes, trace hashes, privacy fixtures, and candidate consistency must match.
optimization_candidates.semantic_privacy_risk: High byte-contract risk; any delimiter, number, escape, ordering, or redaction drift is unacceptable.
optimization_candidates.suspected_redundant_work: std::ostringstream performs much of the remaining stream formatting and output construction for every observation; this phase is a residual partition, not an isolated ostringstream timer.

optimization_candidates.name: copy_and_sort_preparation
optimization_candidates.proposed_optimization_concept: A later experiment could compare sorted views or indexes, but only after proving byte and stability equivalence.
optimization_candidates.required_equivalence_test: Exact canonical bytes/hashes, stable ordering, privacy, and trace equivalence.
optimization_candidates.semantic_privacy_risk: Medium-high; order is canonical and in-place mutation is forbidden without proof.
optimization_candidates.suspected_redundant_work: Multiple vectors are copied and sorted before every rendering pass.

optimization_candidates.name: json_escaping
optimization_candidates.proposed_optimization_concept: Characterize a narrowly scoped escaping implementation only after output-construction results; no rewrite in this audit.
optimization_candidates.required_equivalence_test: Escaping fixtures plus all final canonical byte/hash/privacy gates.
optimization_candidates.semantic_privacy_risk: High; escaping changes canonical bytes and can expose contract drift.
optimization_candidates.suspected_redundant_work: String values are escaped into temporary ostringstream instances during every observation.

optimization_candidates.name: visible_event_history_growth
optimization_candidates.proposed_optimization_concept: First isolate event-history representation or serialization cost in a byte-preserving experiment; do not use deltas or truncation in M4.3.4.
optimization_candidates.required_equivalence_test: Per-observation visible-event arrays, canonical bytes, hashes, paired-world privacy, and trace equivalence.
optimization_candidates.semantic_privacy_risk: Very high; event history order, perspective filtering, and privacy visibility are contract data.
optimization_candidates.suspected_redundant_work: Historical visible events are copied and rendered again in later cumulative observations.

optimization_candidates.name: entity_property_representation
optimization_candidates.proposed_optimization_concept: Measure a representation-level separation of immutable printed metadata before proposing reuse.
optimization_candidates.required_equivalence_test: Per-entity canonical bytes, identity-known/redacted fixtures, hashes, and privacy tests.
optimization_candidates.semantic_privacy_risk: High; redaction and current-versus-printed semantics must remain identical.
optimization_candidates.suspected_redundant_work: Printed and current property objects are reconstructed and rendered for each projected entity.

optimization_candidates.name: static_match_context_repetition
optimization_candidates.proposed_optimization_concept: Evaluate model-facing separation only after a public observation-contract design; do not remove fields here.
optimization_candidates.required_equivalence_test: Exact final observations for both perspectives and all deck-knowledge/privacy fixtures.
optimization_candidates.semantic_privacy_risk: High; deck knowledge and public/private context are part of the observation contract.
optimization_candidates.suspected_redundant_work: Immutable deck and match-context fields are emitted in every observation.

raw_artifact.sidecar_record_policy: Checked-in report contains aggregate scalars and lifecycle proof; raw per-observation shape records remain in the ignored workload artifact.

first_optimization_experiment.concept: Isolated A/B output-construction experiment targeting the rendering residual, with a reserve-backed builder evaluated only against exact byte/hash/privacy equivalence.
first_optimization_experiment.reason: Rendering is the largest measured residual Release serialization partition; copy, sorting, and escaping are much smaller in this workload.
first_optimization_experiment.scope_boundary: Recommendation only. No serializer, event history, static context, hash, ocgcore, or M5 change is implemented by M4.3.4.

size_correlations.interpretation: Correlations are descriptive only and do not establish causation.

visible_event_growth.generation_identity_basis: The canonical simulation constructs one ObservationSession per perspective and never calls clear(); ObservationSession::ingest assigns monotonically increasing event_index values. The uniqueness set is therefore a per-job diagnostic proxy for generated-event identity in this workload, not a durable or canonical event ID. ObservationSession::clear resets that index, and tuple collisions could undercount unique events; both are outside or conservative caveats for this controlled workload.
visible_event_growth.identity_scope: per-job diagnostic proxy tuple (perspective, event_index, engine_step_index, kind)
